company_name: Anhui Bonhao semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — Anhui Bonhao Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. is focused on semiconductor thin film deposition and etching technologies, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Anhui Bonhao Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly in thin film deposition and etching technologies. The company aims to enhance the national semiconductor industry by addressing key bottlenecks and fostering industrial cooperation.

regional_presence.China: The company is rooted in China and actively engages in the localization of semiconductor chip manufacturing equipment R&D.
